applicabilityBasis.summary: msUSD is a crypto-collateralized synthetic debt unit used for DeFi trading and leverage farming. Official documentation shows msUSD minted against collateral and swapped on a DEX to acquire more yield-bearing collateral. The reviewed product and legal materials do not offer msUSD as a general payment instrument or establish an issuer obligation to redeem it for national currency or a national-currency deposit. This assessment follows the documented leverage and yield use, not an automatic exclusion of every CDP stablecoin.

genius.notes: Autonomous Software is named as the interface provider in the terms linked by the project website, not as a legal msUSD redemption obligor. No issuerEntity or domicile is inferred. The terms describe users creating synthetic assets with crypto collateral and disclaim ownership and operation of the open-source protocol. The September 16, 2026 recovery update describes treasury buybacks and collateralized debt, and states that the synth swap remains closed indefinitely. Earlier zero-slippage swap documentation is not treated as a current fixed-value monetary redemption undertaking. Reserve, redemption-policy and monthly-attestation flags are omitted because no separate high-confidence finding on those disclosure fields is proposed. This is a classification within the tracker payment-stablecoin authorization model, not a determination that msUSD is exempt from every financial law.
